title: 60:15 forsaken and hated. Ezek. 16 elaborates on this depiction of Lady Israel as a forsaken and hated woman. She was cast off and left in the street to die, but Jehovah, passing by, saw her, ministered to her, and treated her as royalty. She proved unfaithful to him and so was taken into exile and again treated with shame and disgust. But in the latter days Jehovah will again rescue her and return her to her former glory, renewing his covenant with her.
author: Tina M. Peterson
